items.front: Which IPR is called the 'economic constitution of India'?
items.back: IPR 1956 — created Schedule A (17 state-exclusive industries), tied to the Second Plan.

items.front: What did the New Industrial Policy 1991 do?
items.back: Abolished most licensing; cut reserved industries 17→8 (today only 2: atomic energy, railways).

items.front: Which Act replaced the MRTP Act, and its regulator?
Three types of Public Sector Enterprises with examples?
items.back: Departmental (Railways), statutory corporation (LIC), government company (SAIL, ≥51% govt).
Prior Navratna; net worth ≥₹15,000cr, turnover ≥₹25,000cr, net profit ≥₹5,000cr.

items.front: IBC 2016 — what it replaced and who adjudicates companies?
items.back: Replaced SICA/BIFR; time-bound resolution; NCLT adjudicates company cases.

items.front: Make in India — launch, sectors, target?
items.back: 25 Sep 2014; 25 sectors; 'Zero Defect Zero Effect'; ~25% manufacturing GDP share.
2020; 14 sectors; ~₹1.97 lakh crore; rewards incremental domestic sales.

items.front: Eight Core Industries — IIP weight and members?
items.back: ~40.27% of IIP: coal, crude oil, natural gas, refinery, fertilizers, steel, cement, electricity.

items.front: Four labour codes — count consolidated and in-force date?
items.back: Consolidate 29 central laws; came into force 21 Nov 2025; cover gig/platform workers.
items.examPoint: Four labour codes — in force 21 Nov 2025
